source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-5

procedures.title: Sun visor: attach and adjust
steps: Attach the visor to the windshield header as shown in figure 9 in the manual.
Turn the adjusting screw clockwise to add friction.

procedures.title: Windshield: remove and install
steps: Open the windshield wiper access door.
Take off the wipers.
Remove the L and R weatherstrips: take out the mounting screw, pry from the channel, and pull carefully downward (see figure 11 in the manual).
Remove the L and R lower corner reveal moldings: take out the 2 screws at the end flanges to the fender, then pry gently off the clips.
Remove the L and R side retainer moldings by taking out 3 screws each to the frame (see figure 12 in the manual).
Remove the L and R side reveal moldings by taking out the 1 remaining screw (see figure 13 in the manual).
Mark the molding and header rail with tape for realignment, pry the upper reveal molding out at a corner with a screwdriver (see figure 14 in the manual), then pull the rest free by hand.
Tie one end of the music wire to a wooden handle, push the other end through the caulking at a lower windshield corner, and tie it to a second wooden handle (see figure 15 in the manual).
With a helper, saw through the caulking with the wire: up one side, across the top, down the other side and across the bottom.
Lift the old glass out.
Scrape the caulking off the pinchweld flange with a sharp scraper or wood chisel.
Inspect the upper reveal molding clips (4 needed) and replace any that are bent or distorted.
Glue the rubber spacers in place with weatherstrip adhesive: step-type at the bottom, flat-type at the top and sides (see figure 16 in the manual).

Set the new glass in the opening with suction cups and check its fit to the pinchweld all the way around; overlap must be even and at least 3/16"; shim under the lower spacers if needed to get the overlap at the upper and lower flanges.
Once fit is right, mark the glass and windshield pillar with a grease pencil.
Take the glass out and lay it on a protected surface.
Clean the inside edge of the glass of oil, grease and other contamination.
Peel the backing and apply the pressure sensitive sealing strip about 1/4 inch in from the edge, all around the inside face of the glass.
Brush silane primer around the inside edge surface of the glass and on the sealing surface of the windshield frame.
Cut the cartridge nozzle off along the edge of the paint line.
Mix the caulking material and accelerator thoroughly per the container directions.

specs.what: sealing strip distance from glass edge

notes: Caulking cures soon after air exposure, so glass must go in promptly after the material is applied.

GM kit 4226000 contains caulking material, pressure sensitive sealing strip, .020" music wire and caulking primer; also needed: caulking gun, 2 wood handles, black weatherstrip adhesive, rubber glass spacers.
Figure 10 in the manual identifies the moldings and weatherstrips.
Old caulking need not be fully removed from the frame, but no loose pieces may remain in the opening.
Do the following steps right after mixing the caulking.
